serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Fuck, I always forget that they can read my mind. That just-
Policeman: -sucks.
You: …
Policeman: Listen, no matter what plan or strategy you came up with, it doesn’t matter. I can read your mind AND I have a gun. It’s just impossible to win. Tough luck.
You: We will see…
Policeman: Whatever, let’s get it started.
